verdict.rationale: Calendly documents an official MCP server that turns natural-language commands into Calendly API calls and uses Dynamic Client Registration for OAuth. It publishes a complete tool list mapped to REST endpoints, including event_types-create_event_type, and a probe confirms the MCP doc page exists. The tool-calling surface is backed by documented end-to-end booking for AI agents and by event-type availability endpoints. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the specific MCP tools for availability and booking lookups (only the event-type tool is quoted), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the MCP server.
